text_run.content: The ANN Search has a maximum limit on the number of entities that can be recalled in a single query, and simply using basic ANN Search may not meet the demands of large-scale retrieval. For ANN Search requests where topK exceeds 16,384, it is advisable to consider using the SearchIterator. This section will introduce how to use the SearchIterator and related considerations.

method of this iterator to get the search results.
